# SYNTHETIC fixture (rp5deck test_hotkeys.py) - shaped like ROCKNIX's
# /storage/.config/system/configs/system.cfg, but this exact file was never
# read from a device. It deliberately mixes in credential-looking keys
# (wifi.psk, root.password) alongside the key.* fields hotkeys.py is allowed
# to read, to prove the parser's allow-list excludes everything else.
system.autohotkeys=1
wifi.ssid=SomeNetwork
wifi.psk=hunter2-not-a-real-password
root.password=also-not-real
key.hotkey.a=BTN_TR
key.hotkey.b=BTN_SELECT
key.hotkey.c=BTN_START
key.function.a=BTN_MODE
key.dpad.events=1
key.touchscreen.events=0
